guides.title: Granville Island Public Market
guides.dek: Five stops on Granville Island: Lee's Donuts, JJ Bean Coffee Roasters, A Bread Affair, Siegel's Bagels, and seafood at Dockside Restaurant.

guides.title: Downtown
guides.dek: Thirty downtown, from brunch at Café Medina, OEB and Jam Cafe to sushi at Miku and Minami, Italian at Mortadella and Lupo, seafood at Blue Water Cafe, and cocktails on the Parker Rooftop.

guides.title: Coal Harbour
guides.dek: Coal Harbour on the water: dim sum at Mott 32, seafood at Five Sails and Cardero's, brunch at ARC and Botanist, Nightingale, and Motoretta Gelato for after.

guides.title: Downtown Eastside
guides.dek: The Downtown Eastside: French at St. Lawrence, Italian at Ask For Luigi and Kissa Tanto, cocktails at The Keefer Bar and Laowai, and Mello donuts.

guides.title: Robson Street
guides.dek: Robson Street's spread: ramen at Maruhachi, izakaya at Guu with Garlic, Korean at Kosoo, Japadog, Dinesty, Le Petit Belge, and Joe Fortes for seafood and steak.

guides.title: Financial District
guides.dek: Six in the Financial District: Bel Café in the morning, Hawksworth for brunch, seafood at Coast, and cocktails at Notch8, Prophecy and the 1927 Lobby Lounge.

guides.title: Seafood
guides.dek: Twelve for seafood, from Blue Water Cafe and Coast downtown to The Teahouse in Stanley Park, Dockside on Granville Island, Boulevard in the West End, and Atlas Steak + Fish in Burnaby.

guides.title: Italian
guides.dek: Italian across Vancouver: Mortadella and Lupo downtown, Ask For Luigi and Kissa Tanto in the Downtown Eastside, Savio Volpe on Main Street, L'ufficio in Kitsilano, and Magari by Oca on Commercial.

guides.title: Japanese
guides.dek: Sushi, ramen and tempura: Miku, Minami and Okeya Kyujiro downtown, Sushi Hil on South Main, Ramen DANBO in South Granville, Tendon Kohaku, and PiDGiN in Gastown.

guides.title: Bakery
guides.dek: Nine bakeries, from Purebread in Mount Pleasant and Small Victory in Fairview to Angus T downtown, A Bread Affair and Lee's Donuts on Granville Island, and Mello.

guides.title: French
guides.dek: French from bistro to brasserie: St. Lawrence in the Downtown Eastside, L'abattoir in Gastown, Le Crocodile in the West End, Gary's in Fairview, and The Flying Pig downtown.
